hint: Hover or tap a package or an image family.

parts.title: robin_api
parts.body: The web API, planned. A standalone FastAPI server that gives web apps like SoundHub the same operations as the CLI.

parts.title: robin_cli
parts.body: The robin command operators use today. It calls the run manager's operations and loads deployment packages like soundhub-robin by name.

parts.title: soundhub-robin
parts.body: Lives outside ROBIN, in its own repo: SoundHub's deployment profile and its catalog adapter. The CLI finds it by name; nothing in ROBIN imports it.

parts.title: robin_run_manager
parts.body: The record, the rules and the operations: submit, prepare, launch, record, cancel, withdraw, retry. The only package that touches the database.

parts.title: robin_worker
parts.body: What runs inside a worker image: one work file in, one result file out, for any kind of work its image holds. Never touches the database.

parts.title: robin_adapters
parts.body: The built-in storage, compute and catalog adapters. The run manager only composes them; it never reaches past their interfaces.

parts.title: robin_inference_engine
parts.body: Runs one model the same way for every model: windows the audio, calls the model adapter, checks the output, writes Parquet.

parts.title: robin_models
parts.body: The model adapters (BirdNET, Perch, the Spotted Owl model, classifier heads) and the version table the worker reads.

parts.title: robin_comparison
parts.body: Planned. Scores models against expert labels and picks the clips worth labelling next.

parts.title: robin_fine_tuning
parts.body: Planned. Trains classifier heads on a program's own labels.

parts.title: robin_contracts
parts.body: File formats, port interfaces and shared types. Every package depends on it, and it imports nothing from ROBIN.

parts.title: TensorFlow family
parts.body: The worker image every base model shares today: TensorFlow 2.21 with BirdNET, Perch and OWL.

parts.title: ONNX family
parts.body: A light image for classifier heads, which read stored embeddings instead of raw audio.

parts.title: Comparison family
parts.body: Planned. Its own image with its own libraries, so comparison never shares dependencies with models.

parts.title: Training family
parts.body: Planned, likely PyTorch, for fine-tuning heads.
